highlights: Green Lion Barcelona Smart Glasses - Black
The Green Lion Barcelona Smart Glasses are the perfect combination of style and technology for a hands-free experience.
These smart glasses are designed with an anti-blue lens and UV400 protection to they reduce eye strain.
With Bluetooth V5.4, integrated speakers, and a microphone, these smart glasses enable users to play wireless music, make hands-free calls, and even trigger voice assistants.
This product has intuitive touch controls that enable users to pause/play songs, answer/reject calls, and even control a remote camera.
They contain dual 55mAh batteries for 5 hours of playtime and use magnetic charging, so recharges are quick, taking just 1.5 hours.
